lines.zh: 线头拖过木地板，我跟着自己走。
lines.en: A loose thread drags on the floor, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我的棉花腿每走一步就塌一次。
lines.en: My cotton legs collapse a little with every step.

lines.zh: 玩具城的地板太滑，我总在打转。
lines.en: Toyland floors are slick; I keep spinning in place.

lines.zh: 我踩过积木塔，听见它叫了一声。
lines.en: I step on a block tower and hear it cry out.

lines.zh: 缝线在膝盖处崩开，我又塞回去。
lines.en: The seam splits at my knee, and I stuff it back.

lines.zh: 别看我笨重，我的追击从不拖沓。
lines.en: Do not mistake my bulk for slowness; I never lag.

lines.zh: 我沿着彩漆的边界一路小跑。
lines.en: I jog along the border of the painted floor.

lines.zh: 脚底木轮吱呀，替我数着步数。
lines.en: Wooden wheels creak underfoot, counting my steps.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下面粉似的纤维。
lines.en: Where I pass, I leave a trail of floury fiber.

lines.zh: 这道门框太窄，我得侧着挤过去。
lines.en: This doorway is too narrow; I must squeeze sideways.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体短，像被剪掉了。
lines.en: My shadow is shorter than my body, as if trimmed.

lines.zh: 再走十步，我就能闻到你的汗。
lines.en: Ten more steps and I can smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 我坐着，棉花慢慢从裂缝里冒出来。
lines.en: I sit still while cotton creeps out of my cracks.

lines.zh: 上紧的发条在背后空转，越转越松。
lines.en: The winding key spins loose behind me, idling.

lines.zh: 涂上去的笑脸干了，边缘开始翘起。
lines.en: My painted smile has dried and begun to peel.

lines.zh: 玩具城的夜晚没有风，只有音乐还开着。
lines.en: Toyland nights have no wind, only music left playing.

lines.zh: 我在数自己身上补过几针。
lines.en: I am counting the stitches that have patched me.

lines.zh: 没有心跳声，只有布在慢慢摩擦。
lines.en: No heartbeat, only cloth rubbing slowly against cloth.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛擦亮，它们本来就画在上面。
lines.en: I polish my eyes, though they are only painted on.

lines.zh: 闲着的时候，我像一堆被丢下的衣服。
lines.en: At rest I look like a pile of discarded clothes.

lines.zh: 远处有旋转木马在转，但没有人坐。
lines.en: A carousel turns in the distance with nobody riding it.

lines.zh: 我在等发条彻底停下，那才算睡觉。
lines.en: I wait for the key to stop; only then do I sleep.

lines.zh: 你的脸在我玻璃眼珠里变得很小。
lines.en: Your face shrinks small inside my glass eyeballs.

lines.zh: 你身上没有缝线，这让我很不安。
lines.en: You have no seams, and that unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在等你上发条。
lines.en: I tilt my head, waiting for someone to wind me.

lines.zh: 你的鞋印踩在我的影子上，请挪开。
lines.en: Your footprint covers my shadow; please step aside.

lines.zh: 我在猜你小时候有没有抱过我这样的东西。
lines.en: I wonder if you ever held something like me as a child.

lines.zh: 别笑，我的笑是画上去的，动不了。
lines.en: Do not laugh; my grin is painted and cannot move.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛会转，我的只会反光。
lines.en: Your eyes turn; mine only catch the light.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你比积木有意思。
lines.en: I stare because you are more interesting than blocks.

lines.zh: 靠得太近，你会看见我的针脚。
lines.en: Come closer and you will see my stitching.

lines.zh: 你也是被谁摆在这里的吗。
lines.en: Were you placed here by someone too?

lines.zh: 线开了，棉花往外跑，我按回去。
lines.en: The seam opened and cotton escapes; I push it back.

lines.zh: 我的彩漆裂了，露出底下的木纹。
lines.en: The paint cracked and showed the wood underneath.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了半只耳朵。
lines.en: That blow took half an ear off me.

lines.zh: 我疼，但我的笑掉不下来。
lines.en: I hurt, but the grin will not come off.

lines.zh: 你别打关节，那里只剩几针。
lines.en: Leave my joints alone; only a few stitches hold them.

lines.zh: 针脚崩了三处，我数得清。
lines.en: Three seams burst, and I count them clearly.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛凹进去了，还能看。
lines.en: My eye caved in, but I can still see.

lines.zh: 打吧，反正我不会掉东西。
lines.en: Hit me; nothing will drop from me anyway.

lines.zh: 碎屑落地，我就少一点。
lines.en: Each crumb that falls leaves me smaller.

lines.zh: 你打中的是填充物，不是我。
lines.en: You struck stuffing, not the part that is me.

lines.zh: 你的面包我不吃，我肚子里是棉花。
lines.en: I will not eat your bread; my belly is cotton.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我只对追逐感兴趣。
lines.en: Put it away; I only care about the pursuit.

lines.zh: 食物会弄脏我的彩漆，走开。
lines.en: Food would stain my paint; go away.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，我只想咬你的手。
lines.en: You wave a carrot; I would rather bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我尝不出味道，只尝得出疼。
lines.en: I taste nothing at all, except for pain.

lines.zh: 别拿苹果换我的命，我不缺这个。
lines.en: Do not trade an apple for my life; I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是画的，吞不下去。
lines.en: My mouth is painted on; nothing goes down.

lines.zh: 你喂我，也是想让我安静下来吧。
lines.en: You feed me hoping I will settle down, do you not?

lines.zh: 玩具不吃饭，只喜欢被追着跑。
lines.en: Toys do not eat; they only like being chased.

lines.zh: 把这口吃的留给会饿的东西。
lines.en: Save that mouthful for something that gets hungry.

lines.zh: 撞上来吧，我身上全是软垫。
lines.en: Bump into me; I am padded all over.

lines.zh: 你撞得我棉花往一边挤。
lines.en: You knock my stuffing all to one side.

lines.zh: 我被撞退两步，针脚却没事。
lines.en: I stagger back two steps, but my seams hold.

lines.zh: 别推，我本来就站不太稳。
lines.en: Do not shove; I barely stand steady as it is.

lines.zh: 你肩膀上沾了我的线。
lines.en: You have my thread on your shoulder now.

lines.zh: 撞一下也好，让我确认自己在动。
lines.en: A good bump confirms that I am still moving.

lines.zh: 我们相撞的声音像两只布袋。
lines.en: We collide with the sound of two cloth sacks.

lines.zh: 你的护甲硌得我掉了漆。
lines.en: Your armor scrapes the paint right off me.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，你也挤不过去。
lines.en: I block the doorway; you cannot squeeze past either.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我保证不还手。
lines.en: One more bump and I promise not to hit back.

lines.zh: 玩具城里没有第二个科科。
lines.en: There is no second Koko in Toyland.

lines.zh: 我们是被缝出来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: We were stitched together, not born.

lines.zh: 找伴这件事，发条没教我。
lines.en: The winding key never taught me about company.

lines.zh: 我身边只有掉漆的木马。
lines.en: Only a peeling carousel horse stands beside me.

lines.zh: 同类都堆在仓库深处，落了灰。
lines.en: My kind are stacked in a warehouse, gathering dust.

lines.zh: 就算有伴，也只会一起散架。
lines.en: Even with a partner, we would only fall apart together.

lines.zh: 我闻不出谁是我的家人。
lines.en: I cannot smell out who my family is.

lines.zh: 别替我操心，孤身更省针线。
lines.en: Do not fret for me; being alone saves thread.

lines.zh: 我要的不是伴侣，是能一起追的人。
lines.en: I want not a mate, but someone to chase with.

lines.zh: 这身棉花只够装一个我。
lines.en: There is only enough cotton here for one of me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块积木，随手塞进口袋。
lines.en: I pick up a block and tuck it away.

lines.zh: 这东西好看，但它换不来命。
lines.en: It is pretty, but it cannot buy me a life.

lines.zh: 我的口袋是缝死的，捡了也掉。
lines.en: My pockets are sewn shut; whatever I grab falls out.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的硬币，我先替你收着。
lines.en: I will hold this dropped coin for you.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，我的腰会响。
lines.en: When I bend to pick things up, my back creaks.

lines.zh: 我什么都不掉，所以也别指望我捡。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so expect no pickups from me.

lines.zh: 这截断线是我的，别抢。
lines.en: This cut thread is mine; do not grab at it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西越多，我越舍不得走。
lines.en: The more lies on the floor, the less I want to leave.

lines.zh: 我把你的箭捡起来掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick up your arrow and weigh it.

lines.zh: 捡到手里才发现是块破布。
lines.en: Only in my hand do I find it is torn cloth.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，从积木塔后面。
lines.en: I see you, there behind the block tower.

lines.zh: 有活的东西进来了，我的发条紧了。
lines.en: Something living entered; my key winds tight.

lines.zh: 你踩响地板，就等于叫了我。
lines.en: Your step creaks the floor, which is as good as calling.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，我的笑又固定了一度。
lines.en: Target locked; my painted grin hardens one degree.

lines.zh: 八点五点的力气，够用了。
lines.en: Eight and a half points of force will do.

lines.zh: 别跑，我追起来比看着快。
lines.en: Do not run; I am faster than I look.

lines.zh: 你不是玩具，但你可以当玩具。
lines.en: You are not a toy, but you can serve as one.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，和我完全不同。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat; it sounds nothing like mine.

lines.zh: 缝线的尽头动了，就是猎物。
lines.en: The end of my thread twitches: prey.

lines.zh: 四颗心里的力气都往腿上跑。
lines.en: All the strength in forty hearts runs to my legs.

lines.zh: 我把门堵住，你只剩一个方向。
lines.en: I block the door, leaving you one direction.

lines.zh: 玩具城的规矩：进来就得陪着玩。
lines.en: Toyland rule: whoever enters must play along.

lines.zh: 眼睛转过去了，别想躲开。
lines.en: My eyes have turned; there is no hiding.

lines.zh: 我挑你，是因为你没被缝死。
lines.en: I chose you because you are not sewn shut.

lines.zh: 线头一动，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: A loose thread stirs and I know where you are.

lines.zh: 进来的人，都要陪我玩到结束。
lines.en: Anyone who enters plays with me until the end.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收窄距离，像拧紧的螺丝。
lines.en: I narrow the gap slowly, like a tightening screw.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，木头味更明显了。
lines.en: Backed into the corner, you smell more of wood.

lines.zh: 我的目光钉在你胸口，那里跳得最快。
lines.en: My gaze pins your chest, where it beats fastest.

lines.zh: 别找我的背后，那里只有发条。
lines.en: Do not aim for my back; there is only a key.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，像一面小墙。
lines.en: You raise your shield like a little wall.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一次后退的方向。
lines.en: I am calculating where you will step back next.

lines.zh: 呼吸乱了，你已经输了半招。
lines.en: Your breathing broke rhythm; you have half lost.

lines.zh: 玩具不眨眼，我也不会。
lines.en: Toys do not blink, and neither will I.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑比我的胳膊短。
lines.en: Your sword is shorter than my arm.

lines.zh: 再绕一圈，我就把你的路走熟了。
lines.en: Circle once more and I will learn your route.

lines.zh: 我不吼，我的声音是缝起来的。
lines.en: I do not roar; my voice is sewn shut.

lines.zh: 你带着伤，脚步已经开始偏了。
lines.en: You are wounded; your steps already drift sideways.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在你脚上，别动。
lines.en: My shadow lies across your feet; hold still.

lines.zh: 这一场追逐，从你进门就开始了。
lines.en: This chase began the moment you walked in.

lines.zh: 我把步子踩得很轻，布不响。
lines.en: I step so lightly the cloth never rustles.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的线就绷紧一点。
lines.en: Each step you take back tightens my stitches.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，那里没有盾。
lines.en: I circle to your side, where there's no shield.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，一下一下。
lines.en: I count your breaths, one by one.

lines.zh: 门在我后面，窗子太高。
lines.en: The door is behind me and the window's too high.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的眼睛，那是扣子。
lines.en: Don't stare at my eyes; they're only buttons.

lines.zh: 这一拳是棉花包的，照样疼。
lines.en: This fist is padded with cotton and still hurts.

lines.zh: 八点五点伤害，我算得很准。
lines.en: Eight and a half points, and I aim exactly.

lines.zh: 你听见布面拍在骨头上的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear cloth slap against bone?

lines.zh: 我的指节没有骨头，只有线。
lines.en: My knuckles have no bone, only thread.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护甲缝里。
lines.en: This blow lands in the gap of your armor.

lines.zh: 别挡，我还没使出全力。
lines.en: Do not block; I have not used my full strength.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我就跟半步。
lines.en: You retreat half a step; I follow half a step.

lines.zh: 打完之后我的手掌会塌下去。
lines.en: After the strike my palm flattens out.

lines.zh: 布屑落了你一身，抱歉。
lines.en: Lint falls all over you; my apologies.

lines.zh: 我的重击像有人把沙发推过来。
lines.en: My heavy swing feels like a couch shoved at you.

lines.zh: 你流血的温度，让我想起灯。
lines.en: The warmth of your blood reminds me of lamps.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，你的心跳会更响。
lines.en: Take one more hit and your heart will beat louder.

lines.zh: 我把力道压在肩缝上，那里结实。
lines.en: I put the force through my shoulder seam; it holds.

lines.zh: 这场游戏，我赢在不知疲倦。
lines.en: In this game I win by never tiring.

lines.zh: 我的拳头没有骨头，落下来却沉。
lines.en: My fist has no bones, but it lands heavy.

lines.zh: 这一下拍在你的肩上，布屑飞了。
lines.en: That slap on your shoulder throws off cloth dust.

lines.zh: 我伸长手臂，线在响。
lines.en: I stretch my arm and the threads creak.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，我的棉花漏出来。
lines.en: You block once and my stuffing spills out.

lines.zh: 我把你按在积木墙上。
lines.en: I pin you against the block wall.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我的笑会歪。
lines.en: One more hit and my smile will go crooked.

lines.zh: 我从积木堆里被翻出来，身上全是灰。
lines.en: I am dug out of the block pile, covered in dust.

lines.zh: 发条最后一响，我就睁眼了。
lines.en: The key clicked once more, and my eyes opened.

lines.zh: 玩具城又添了一个会走的东西。
lines.en: Toyland gains another thing that walks.

lines.zh: 谁把我缝好的，我不记得了。
lines.en: I do not remember who stitched me together.

lines.zh: 刚站起来时，我的膝盖是软的。
lines.en: When I first stood, my knees were soft.

lines.zh: 我的彩漆还没干，别碰我。
lines.en: My paint is still wet; do not touch me.

lines.zh: 这地方太空了，我决定填一填。
lines.en: This place is too empty, so I will fill it.

lines.zh: 我闻到新鲜的味道，就醒了。
lines.en: I woke because I smelled something fresh.

lines.zh: 木马底下，是我睁开眼的地方。
lines.en: Under the carousel is where I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 第一天我就知道：这里没有同伴。
lines.en: On day one I knew: there are no companions here.

lines.zh: 缝合处还在痒，说明我还活着。
lines.en: My stitches still itch, which means I am alive.

lines.zh: 一出生就背着四十颗心。
lines.en: I was born already carrying forty hearts.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到袖子，棉花立刻发黄。
lines.en: Flame licks my sleeve and the cotton yellows.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我的腿先散开。
lines.en: Falling from height, my legs come apart first.

lines.zh: 水吸饱了棉花，我沉得很快。
lines.en: The cotton drinks the water and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 气浪把我送出去，我成了一把线。
lines.en: The blast throws me and I become loose thread.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我胸口，像别了枚胸针。
lines.en: The arrow pins my chest like a brooch.

lines.zh: 药水的味道钻进缝里，我发麻。
lines.en: Potion vapor seeps into my seams and numbs me.

lines.zh: 我不吃，可我饿，这没道理。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I starve; that makes no sense.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，亮了一瞬又暗了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; I lit up once and went dark.

lines.zh: 虚空拉着我的线，一根根往回抽。
lines.en: The void pulls my threads out one by one.
